title: Industrial Notice / Rigel Manufacturing
summary: Trade bulletin entry concerning industrial contractor Hephaestus Rigel.
body:
TRADE BULLETIN

HEPHAESTUS RIGEL

Listed in historical procurement notices as an industrial contractor involved in specialised manufacturing and technical supply.

The bulletin provides no current assessment of ownership, affiliation or operational activity. Several associated businesses have since changed names or ownership.

ARCHIVE NOTE

A withdrawn Brightside personnel record is held under ARC-326-0421.
